tools.name: rules_digest
tools.description: Free. The current US trading, margin, settlement and tax rules an agent must follow, with effective dates and sources. Includes changes your training data may predate, such as the June 2026 replacement of the Pattern Day Trader rule. Price: free.

tools.name: pre_trade_check
tools.description: Run an order past a compliance officer and risk manager before sending it to the broker. Checks buying power, cash-account settlement violations, FINRA intraday margin (post-PDT) or legacy PDT limits, Reg SHO short-sale rules, wash-sale exposure, position concentration, per-trade risk versus stop, l

tools.name: position_size
tools.description: Size a position the way a risk manager would: fixed-fractional risk to a stop, volatility targeting (ATR or annualized vol), or fractional Kelly from your edge statistics. Applies a max-position cap and round lots, and explains the binding constraint. Price: $0.005.

tools.name: tax_lot_plan
tools.description: Act as the tax advisor for a sale: compares FIFO, LIFO, HIFO and minimum-tax lot selection, splits short- and long-term gains, estimates tax, flags wash sales, and notes lots about to turn long-term. With mode=harvest it scans positions for tax-loss harvesting. Price: $0.02.

tools.name: portfolio_review
tools.description: A periodic advisor review of a portfolio: weights, concentration (HHI and effective number of holdings), sector and asset-class exposure, drift from targets with the trades to rebalance, and, given return history, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, VaR/CVaR and beta. Ends with prioritized findin

tools.name: strategy_audit
tools.description: An independent performance auditor for a trading strategy or backtest. From a trade list and/or periodic returns it computes win rate, expectancy, profit factor, streaks, Sharpe/Sortino/drawdown, and tests whether the edge is real: t-stat, Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio and the Deflated Sharpe Ratio tha

tools.name: suitability_check
tools.description: The compliance review a robo-advisor or advisory agent should run before recommending a portfolio to a person: compares the proposal with the client's age, horizon, risk tolerance, liquidity needs and experience under Reg BI / fiduciary standards, flags complex products, and returns a timestamped, h

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pre_trade_check, suitability_check · Private data: suitability_check · Public sink: pre_trade_check · Destructive: pre_trade_check, suitability_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pre_trade_check, suitability_check · Private data: suitability_check · Public sink: pre_trade_check · Destructive: pre_trade_check, suitability_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
